parent_objective: run one 8192-step guarded PPO proposal from the current public-gate base and gate it with the expanded public proof stack
blocked_by: M1068 admits a single conservative medium-ramp PPO proposal after family-intersection gate propagation is fixed
invalidates: claiming medium PPO safety without an expanded-gate 8192-step proposal

public_gates: M1069 must run exactly one 8192-step guarded PPO proposal
M1069 must not use private holdout
M1069 must preserve the P0 actor-input contract
M1069 must gate the raw PPO checkpoint against exact M997/M297/M270 and combined active-set checks
M1069 must gate the raw PPO checkpoint against six old public proof replay surfaces
M1069 must gate the raw PPO checkpoint against the M1061 family-intersection public proof gate
M1069 must gate source-diverse diagnostics, fresh public seeds, moderate-OOD seed, and behavior ablations
M1069 must fail on M267/M264 row15 wrong-history success, M183/M170 row16 normal-history failure, or any M1061 source-to-candidate family-intersection success-drop loss
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run multiple medium seeds
do not run 16k or long PPO
do not skip exact or combined active-set checks
do not skip proof replay gates
do not relax the M1061 family-intersection gate
do not accept aggregate eval if row15 row16 or family-intersection proof washes out
do not change loss coefficients while testing this medium-ramp escalation

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether the current public-gate base can survive one doubled-step PPO proposal under exact public proof replay family-intersection source-diverse fresh/OOD and behavior gates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: single-seed medium-ramp diagnostic only; no promotion, no private holdout, no repeatability claim, no medium/long stability claim
stop_condition: stop if PPO crashes or metrics are non-finite
stop if exact or combined active-set retention regresses
stop if any old public proof replay surface fails
stop if M1061 family-intersection public proof gate fails
stop if row15 wrong-history failure or row16 normal-history success flips
fallback_plan: if all gates pass, route to an 8192-step fresh-seed repeat before any promotion
if exact or proof gates fail, route to localized medium PPO proof-washout audit before recipe changes
if family-intersection gate fails, route to family-intersection active-set audit
if training is unstable, route to PPO recipe audit
if fresh/OOD/behavior regresses while proof holds, route to generalization or behavior regression audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1068 admits the first medium-ramp PPO proposal after expanded family-intersection proof gate integration and propagation fix

hypothesis: One 8192-step guarded PPO proposal from the M1052 public-gate base can complete with finite metrics and preserve exact, proof, family-intersection, source-diverse, fresh/OOD, and behavior gates without promotion.
success_criteria: exact and combined active-set gates pass
all six old public replay surfaces pass
fresh public and moderate-OOD gates pass
row15 row16 and M1061 family-intersection rollback checks pass
no promotion or private holdout occurs
failure_criteria: PPO run crashes or checkpoint is missing
exact or combined active-set gate fails
decision_rule: M1069 may only run one 8192-step PPO proposal and gate its raw checkpoint. It cannot promote, use private holdout, or claim repeatability.
